title: Institute of Health
description: Greyscale paper for a health-education school: #f1f1f1 page, #e6e6e6 bands, white active cards, #242424 ink and filled buttons, #d9d9d9 square icon buttons, hairline borders and no shadows. One neo-grotesk at weight 500, tight and dense. A deep blood red is kept for the media placeholders behind the story and closing CTA. Dark sibling: the #242424 footer slab as the page.
notes: light is the faithful mode; .dark is the original's #242424 footer slab, which instituteofhealth-footer uses on its own
Hanken Grotesk stands in for Lay Grotesk (closed)
highlight and glow are the blood reds used only by media placeholders (story, CTA)
gutter and section padding grow at 1024px (16px → 32px, 3.5rem → 6rem)
name: instituteofhealth-theme
